questions.question: Which of the following numbers is divisible by 36?

questions.solution:
Number = 29412

The sum of digits = 2 + 9 + 4 + 1 + 2 = 18. 18 is divisible by 9. So the number is also divisible by 9.

The last two digits = 12. 12 is divisible by 4. So the number is divisible by 4.

29412 is divisible by 36.

questions.question: Which of the following numbers is divisible by 9?
questions.questionHtml: <!-- x-tinymce/html -->Which of the following numbers is divisible by 9?
questions.solution:
Shortcut Trick

A number is divisible by 9 if the sum of its digits is divisible by 9.

Sum of digits for 553986 = 5 + 5 + 3 + 9 + 8 + 6 = 36.

Since 36 is divisible by 9 (9 × 4 = 36), the number is divisible by 9.

∴ The correct answer is 553986.

Alternate Method

Given: Numbers (1) 553986, (2) 350846, (3) 941201, (4) 132490.

Divisibility Rule: A number is divisible by 9 if Σn is a multiple of 9.

⇒ Option 1: 5 + 5 + 3 + 9 + 8 + 6 = 36 (Divisible by 9)

⇒ Option 2: 3 + 5 + 0 + 8 + 4 + 6 = 26 (Not divisible by 9)

⇒ Option 3: 9 + 4 + 1 + 2 + 0 + 1 = 17 (Not divisible by 9)

⇒ Option 4: 1 + 3 + 2 + 4 + 9 + 0 = 19 (Not divisible by 9)

∴ The correct answer is 553986.

Additional Information

Divisibility by 3

A number is divisible by 3 if the sum of its digits is a multiple of 3.

Divisibility by 6

A number is divisible by 6 if it is even and also divisible by 3.

Divisibility by 11

The difference between the sum of digits at odd places and even places must be 0 or a multiple of 11.

questions.solution:
Given:

A number is divided by 3, the remainder will be 2

Calculation:

let the number be X

X = 3K + 2

According to question

X + 5 = 3K + 2 + 5

⇒X + 5 = 3K + 7

⇒X + 5 = 3K + 6 + 1

⇒X + 5 = 3(K + 2) + 1

Now,

3(K + 2) type number is definitely divisible by 3 so the remainder will be 1

questions.question: A number is divided by 49 leaves a remainder 9. If the same number is divided by 7, then the remainder will be :
questions.questionHtml: A number is divided by 49 leaves a remainder 9. If the same number is divided by 7, then the remainder will be :
questions.solution:
GIVEN:

A number leaves a remainder 9 when divided by 49

FORMULA USED:

Dividend = Divisor × Quotient + Remainder 

CALCULATION:

Let X is the number and when it is divided by 49 it gives remainder 9 and quotient Y

We know that ,

Dividend = Divisor × Quotient + Remainder ...................eq(1)

According to the question:

⇒ X = 49 ×Y + 9 

This equation can be written as:

⇒ X = 7 × (7 × Y) + 7 + 2 

⇒ X = 7 × Y' + 7 + 2 

Taking out 7 common, we get 

⇒ X = 7 (Y' + 1) + 2 

⇒ X = 7× Y'' + 2  ...................................eq(2) 

Hence, on comparing eq (1) and eq (2) we find that when the same number X is divided by 7 we get remainder as 2.

Hence, on dividing the number by 7 the remainder is 2.

questions.question: Which of the following numbers is divisible by 33?
questions.questionHtml: Which of the following numbers is divisible by 33?
questions.solution:
• Concept used:

    The divisibility rule of 3 states that a number is completely divisible by 3 if the sum of its digits is divisible by 3.

    The divisibility rule of 11 states that the difference between the sum of the digits at even places and odd places is

    either be 0 or divisible by 11.

    Calculations:

    Factors of the number 33 is

    ⇒ 33 = 3 × 11

    So, the number which is divisible by 33 is also divisible by 3 and 11

    Now, we go through option elimination method

    Option (1) is 178750

    ⇒ 178750 = 1 + 7 + 8 + 7 + 5 + 0 = 28  [not divisible by 3]

    Option (2) is 164461

    ⇒ 164461 = 1 + 6 + 4 + 4 + 6 + 1 = 22  [not divisible by 3]

    Option (3) is 185592

    ⇒ 185592 = 1 + 8 + 5 + 5 + 9 + 2 = 30 [divisible by 3]

    Option (4) is 171116

    ⇒171116 = 1 + 7 + 1 + 1 + 1 + 6 = 17 [not divisible by 3]

    Now, Check 185592 is divisible by 11 or not

    Take the sum of digits at odd places,

    ⇒ 1 + 5 + 9 = 15

    Take the sum of digits at even places,

    ⇒ 8 + 5 + 2 = 15

    Difference between the sum of the digits at even places and odd places is

    ⇒ 15 – 15 = 0

    And, 0 is divisible by 11

    So, 185592 is divisible by 33

    ∴ 185592 is divisible by 33

  •

questions.question: If the number 579683pq is divisible by both 5 and 8, then the smallest possible values of p and q will be:
questions.questionHtml: If the number 579683pq is divisible by both 5 and 8, then the smallest possible values of p and q will be:
questions.solution:
Shortcut Trick

For divisibility by 5, q must be 0 or 5.

Since the number is also divisible by 8 (an even number), q must be 0.

For divisibility by 8, the last three digits 3p0 must be divisible by 8.

Testing smallest p: If p = 0, 300 (No); if p = 1, 310 (No); if p = 2, 320 (Yes, 320 ÷ 8 = 40).

∴ The correct answer is p = 2, q = 0.

Alternate Method

Given: Number = 579683pq, Divisors = 5 and 8.

Step 1: Divisibility by 5

⇒ A number is divisible by 5 if its last digit is 0 or 5.

⇒ q = 0 or q = 5.

Step 2: Divisibility by 8

⇒ A number is divisible by 8 if its last three digits are divisible by 8.

⇒ If q = 5, the number is odd, so it cannot be divisible by 8. ∴ q = 0.

⇒ The last three digits are 3p0.

Step 3: Finding smallest p

⇒ For p = 0: 300 ÷ 8 = 37.5 (Not divisible)

⇒ For p = 1: 310 ÷ 8 = 38.75 (Not divisible)

⇒ For p = 2: 320 ÷ 8 = 40 (Divisible)

∴ The correct answer is p = 2, q = 0.

Additional Information

Divisibility by 8

A number is divisible by 8 if the number formed by its last three digits is divisible by 8 or if the last three digits are 000.

Divisibility by 5

A number is divisible by 5 if its units digit is either 0 or 5.

Divisibility by 40

If a number is divisible by both 5 and 8 (which are co-prime), it must be divisible by their product, 40.

questions.question: What will be the smallest natural number to be filled in the blank for the number ’23_45678’ to be divisible by 22?

If a number is divisible by 22 then the number also divisible by 2 and 11

The last digit of the number is 8, which is divisible by 2

The divisibility rule of 11 is the difference between the sum of the odd place of a number and the sum of even place is equal to 0 or 11.

The difference is, ⇒ 21 - (14 + x) = either 0 or 11

For 0, ⇒ 21 - (14 + x) = 0 ⇒ 21 - 14 - x = 0 ⇒ x = 7

For 11 ⇒ 21 - (14 + x) = 11 ⇒ 21 - 14 - x = 11 ⇒ x = 7 - 11 ⇒ x = -4

The digit cannot be negative, so ⇒ x = 7

questions.question: When an integer n is divided by 6, the remainder is 5. What is the remainder if 9n is divided by 6?
questions.questionHtml: When an integer n is divided by 6, the remainder is 5. What is the remainder if 9n is divided by 6?
questions.solution:
Given:

When an integer n is divided by 6, the remainder is 5

Formula:

Number = quotient × Divisor + remainder

Calculation:

n = quotient × 6 + 5

9n = 9(6 × quotient + 5) 

= 9 × 6 × quotient + 5 × 9

= 9 × 6 × quotient + 7 × 6 + 3

= 6(9quotient + 7) + 3

∴ 3 is the remainder if 9n is divided by 6.

Alternate MethodLet the integer be (6 + 5) = 11

Now, 9n = 9 × 11 = 99

When we divide 99 by 6 we get 16 as quotient and 3 as remainder.

∴ 3 is the remainder if 9n is divided by 6.

questions.question: XY7B is a 4-digit number divisible by 4. What is the largest value of B?
questions.questionHtml: XY7B is a 4-digit number divisible by 4. What is the largest value of B?
questions.solution:
Since XY7B is a 4-digit number divisible by 4, B must be even. The possible values for B are 0, 2, 4, 6, and 8.

So the last two digits will be 70, 72, 76, and 78.

Now, only 72 and 76 are divisible by 4

So the largest value of B is 6

questions.question: If m is even, then 8 m - 1 is divisible by:
questions.questionHtml: If m is even, then 8<sup>m</sup> - 1 is divisible by:
questions.solution:
m = 2n ⇒ 8m - 1 = 8(2n) - 1 = (8n)² - 1² = (8n - 1)(8n + 1)

⇒ 8 ≡ 1 (mod 7) ⟹ 8n - 1 ≡ 0 (mod 7)

⇒ 8 ≡ -1 (mod 9) ⟹ (-1)² = 1 ⟹ 8n - 1 ≡ 0 (mod 9)

LCM(7, 9) = 63 ⟹ 8m - 1 is divisible by 63.

questions.question: The remainder when 72 × 73 × 78 × 76 is divided by 35 is:
questions.questionHtml: The remainder when 72 × 73 × 78 × 76 is divided by 35 is:
questions.solution:
Given:

(72 × 73 × 78 × 76) divided by 35

Concept Used:

We divide every number individually by 35 and remainder left will be operated as signs given in the original equation, and if the operated value is more than 35 then we will divide it further till we get values less than 35 and that value will be remainder for the given equation.

Calculation:

(72 × 73 × 78 × 76)/35

⇒ (2 × 3 × 8 × 6)/35

⇒ 288/35

⇒ 8/35

Since 8 cannot be divided further by 35

∴ The remainder of the given equation is 8

questions.question: What are the values of ‘&’ and ‘#’, respectively, if the following number is perfectly divisible by 9? 51&918#0
questions.questionHtml:
What are the values of ‘&’ and ‘#’, respectively, if the following number is perfectly divisible by 9?

51&918#0
questions.solution:
Given:

51&918#0

Concept used:

Divisibility rule of 9 ⇒ If the sum of digits of the number is divisible by 9, then the number itself is divisible by 9.

Calculation:

1. 9 and 8

⇒ 51991880 → 5 + 1 + 9 + 9 + 1 + 8 + 8 + 0 = 41

Since 41 is not divisible by 9, then the number formed is not perfectly divisible by 9.

2. 2 and 2

51291820 → 5 + 1 + 2 + 9 + 1 + 8 + 2 + 0 = 28

Since 28 is not divisible by 9, then the number formed is not perfectly divisible by 9.

3. 4 and 5

51491850 → 5 + 1 + 4 + 9 + 1 + 8 + 5 + 0 = 33

Since 33 is not divisible by 9, then the number formed is not perfectly divisible by 9.

4. 8 and 4

51891840 → 5 + 1 + 8 + 9 + 1 + 8 + 4 + 0 = 36

Since 36 is divisible by 9, then the number formed is perfectly divisible by 9.

Hence, the correct answer is option 4.

questions.question: Find the least number divisible by 2, 3, 5, 6, 9 and 18, which is a perfect square.
questions.questionHtml: Find the least number divisible by 2, 3, 5, 6, 9 and 18, which is a perfect square.
questions.solution:
LCM (2, 3, 5, 6, 9 and 18) = 90

90 = 2 x 3 x 3 x 5.

As 2 and 5 are not in pair in LCM’s factor so we need to multiply 90 by 5 and 2 to make it a perfect square.

90 x 2 x 5  = 900.
